about: Strategy Tester jobs for the tester agent (tools/autopilot/prompts/tester.md). jobs.note: Runs after j1 and j2. a1 approved 2026-10-17 (backup made). AurumFunded in Terminal 16 is already linked to the repo; the demo EA runs the same source, so the recompile only reloads it. Base run judged by the orchestrator 2026-10-17 05:55: +167.68%, 6.67% eq DD, 17 day stops - matches. The expect above was taken from the v1.00 run (size cap 1.0); 1.01+ caps the cushion at 1.4, and on that sizing the Python model gives +331% / 7.2% (legs off), so the tester keeps 67% of the model's log growth (v1.00 run: 70%) and the drawdown is inside the model's 6.2-7.2%. Corrected expectation for the legs-on run (model +381% / 8.4%, cap 1.0 check +212% / 6.0% = the +213% / 6.0% above): about +185-190% and 7.5-8% eq DD, more day stops than 17 (research/funded_tester_gap.py). Legs-on run judged by the orchestrator 2026-10-17 07:10: +221.48% / 8.28% eq DD / 21 day stops against about +185-190% / 7.5-8% - better than expected (74% of the model's log growth against 67% off), drawdown 0.3 points over. Return per drawdown 25.1 -> 26.7, worst day -2.70% -> -2.55%; the 2024 day stops are the same two days in both runs, the 4 extra come in late 2025-2026 when equity is 2.5x+ and the 3%-of-initial stop is about 1.2% of equity. Both legs pass step 16 in AurumFunded (noise: US100.cash +977, US500.cash -57).

Judged by the orchestrator 2026-10-17 07:10: inconclusive, a set-up fault, not an EA result. The set list renamed only 4 of Hydra's 16 symbol inputs; InpStocks (SP500.r), InpNasdaq (NAS100.r), the four fix pairs and six yen crosses kept the other broker's names, so the fix, stock-fall, Tokyo morning, after-holiday and noise legs never traded (by symbol only EURUSD, USDJPY, AUDCAD), the gold legs found the 100 deposit too small for the minimum lot, and the preset stops after one goal round (2024-01). The legs-on run therefore added only the breakout, for one month, at minimum-lot rounding. Replaced by j5.

jobs.note: Queued by the orchestrator 2026-10-17 07:10 after j4 proved a set-up fault. New preset AurumHydra_FTMO_size1.set: FTMO names for all 16 symbol inputs (AurumFunded's defaults, all traded in j3), size 1, no goal mode, the EA's default 35% drawdown halt. Tester 2026-10-17 09:45: both runs done but IDENTICAL to the cent (+1460.44%, 13.11% eq DD, 4174 trades, PF 1.53). Both reports list InpBreakRiskPct=0.5 although the off run's tester.ini and the preset hold no such key: the off run probably inherited j4's leg values, so no valid off/on pair. Needs a legs-off rerun with explicit InpBreakRiskPct=0,InpNoiseMult=0. See summary.md in the on folder. Judged by the orchestrator 2026-10-17 10:05: confirmed and wider than the legs. The off run's report lists every input j4's legs-on run had that the size1 preset left out: InpBreakRiskPct=0.5, InpNoiseMult=0.275, InpMonthEndBoost=2.0 (bell, Tokyo and both fix legs doubled on each month's last weekday), InpMaxDrawdownPct=0.0 (no 35% halt; it would not have fired at 13.1%), and the goal inputs (inert at InpGoalMult=0). So both j5 runs are legs on WITH the month-end boost: +1460.44% / 13.11% eq DD, return per DD 111, about 97% of the legs-on model's log growth (ln 15.60 / ln 16.74; the boost is not in the model). No step 16 verdict. j3's inputs were checked the same way: all at the EA defaults or the funded preset, so j3 stands. Replaced by j6.
